items.title: Copper Prices Looked Unstoppable. Why They’re Suddenly Tumbling.
items.summary: Insatiable demand for artificial-intelligence infrastructure was a key factor in the copper rally, but another catalyst is suddenly in doubt.

items.title: 1 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks to Keep an Eye On and 2 We Brush Off
items.summary: Wall Street is overwhelmingly bullish on the stocks in this article, with price targets suggesting significant upside potential. However, it’s worth remembering that analysts rarely issue sell ratings, partly because their firms often seek other business from the same companies they cover.

items.title: 1 Oversold Stock Primed to Rebound and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: The past year hasn’t been kind to the stocks featured in this article. Each has tumbled to its lowest point in 12 months, leaving investors to decide whether they’re witnessing fire sales or falling knives.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock Worth Investigating and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: The Anti-AI ETF Is Here, and Its Biggest Holdings Are Engines, Trucks and Air Conditioners
items.summary: A new ETF built on diesel engines, truck fleets, and air conditioners is pitching itself as a refuge from software-heavy portfolios, but its biggest holding may already be cashing in on the very trend it claims to avoid.

items.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Lennox Stock?
items.summary: Lennox has significantly underperformed the broader market amid weaker residential demand and reduced guidance, while analysts remain moderately optimistic about its prospects.

items.title: 2 Reasons to Like LII (and 1 Not So Much)
items.summary: Over the last six months, Lennox’s shares have sunk to $437.64, producing a disappointing 17.3% loss - a stark contrast to the S&P 500’s 10.9% gain. This might have investors contemplating their next move.
